definitions.image_gradient: Mean across available native RGB frames of the mean absolute horizontal/vertical neighbor difference of luminance 0.299R+0.587G+0.114B, RGB/255; equal axis weight.
definitions.image_clipping: Mean fraction of native RGB channel values <=1/255 or >=254/255 across available frames.
definitions.image_contrast: Mean population SD of native luminance per frame.
definitions.unique_frame_fraction: Number of actually received distinct frame IDs divided by 16; clipped to [0,1].
definitions.sensor_finite_fraction: Finite raw values divided by all expected raw values in each action interval, pooled over five native streams and 22 channels; missing samples/channels are NaN.
definitions.available_channel_fraction: Fraction of the 22 channels with at least two finite in-interval raw samples.
definitions.sensor_max_gap_fraction: Mean over channels of largest gap between finite native timestamps including action boundaries, divided by action duration; no finite samples gives 1.
definitions.sensor_relative_variation: log1p of mean per-channel finite population SD divided by that branch G-only raw-channel SD; each ratio capped at 1000; zero/undefined G scales omitted, unavailable channels contribute 0; no usable scales gives 0.
definitions.normalization: Weighted mean and population SD from only that outer fold fusion-training variants; sample weights 0.5/0.25/0.25. SD<=1e-6 replaced by 1; standardized q clipped to [-10,10]. p probabilities unstandardized; interactions use this q.
definitions.image_missing: All four image descriptors set 0 if no received frames; explicit absence routes to the surviving branch, never a fitted head.
definitions.quality_missing: Defined finite sentinel behavior as above; no pristine input, identity, fault name, severity, seed, label or correctness enters quality.
